title: A transparent PNG pasted or dropped onto an ink page gets a black background
detail: readImage() in inkui.js draws every picture (paste, drop, Image… from the palette) onto a canvas and keeps it as toDataURL('image/jpeg'). JPEG has no alpha, so every transparent pixel becomes black: a diagram, a screenshot with transparency or a cut-out pasted onto a lined page shows a black box behind it on the paper.
evidence: js/core/inkui.js:1400-1413 (c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.86) with no fill first); compare js/core/imagecrop.js:110-124 which keeps PNG/WebP or fills a background before JPEG
fix: Keep image/png when the source is PNG/WebP/GIF (or when the canvas has any alpha < 255), or fill the canvas white before drawImage when JPEG is chosen.
rootCause: Unconditional JPEG encoding of user pictures

title: Pen and ink says a pen without pressure follows 'speed and tilt'; tilt is never read
detail: The 'Your pen' card says 'It reports no pressure, so the width follows your speed and tilt.' Neither ink.js nor inkui.js reads tiltX/tiltY/altitudeAngle; width without pressure comes from speed only (invariant 132).
evidence: js/modules/inkset.js:56 text; grep 'tilt' js/core/ink.js js/core/inkui.js returns nothing
fix: Say 'so the width follows your speed.'

title: Readiness band line on iPhone squeezes the sentence into a ~80px column, one word per line
detail: On #/exams/readiness at 402px the band chip and 'limiting: RAG' take the left of the bandline and the explanation ('SAMPLE — Mock exam (edit me) · Sat 7 Nov · 5 days. RAG is holding it at Not enough evidence.') is crushed into a narrow right column running nine lines, beside empty space under the chip; 'Plan the gap' drops to its own row.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/empty-readiness-iphone.png (top card); js/modules/examviews.js:45-48 builds the line with .k-ex-grow; css/views/exams.css:20 .k-ex-grow { flex: 1 1 0; min-inline-size: 0 } inside .k-ex-bandline (exams.css:279, flex-wrap: wrap)
fix: In .k-ex-bandline give the text a real basis (flex: 1 1 16rem) so it wraps to its own full-width line when narrow; or stack the bandline in a column under 560.
rootCause: flex-basis 0 on a wrapping flex item never wraps, it shrinks

title: Planner rows on iPhone truncate every topic name to a few letters and wrap the group total
detail: #/exams/plan at 402px: each priority row is a three-column grid (text, session squares, time). With a 'learn first' chip inside the same ellipsised line the topic shows as 'Methods o…', 'Laws of indic…', 'Quadratic function…', so the user can't tell what to study. The group header's total '5 h 50' wraps onto two lines beside the Mock chip.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/empty-plan-iphone.png; js/modules/examviews.js:239-243 (chip and title inside one .k-ex-ell); css/views/exams.css:384 .k-ex-prow grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto var(--sp-64)
fix: Under 560 put the session squares under the text (grid-template-areas) and let the title wrap to two lines (line-clamp 2) with the chip on the why line; give the header total white-space: nowrap.
rootCause: Fixed three-column row with single-line ellipsis at phone width

title: Readiness 'Coverage' rows on iPhone ellipsise topic names while the Pacing note keeps full width
detail: Rows like 'Quadratic functions & …', 'Graphs of functio…', 'Parametric …' are cut while 'Pacing: week of 18 Jan 2027' is shown whole. The topic name is the primary information.
fix: Let the note go under the title at phone width, or shorten it to the date ('18 Jan') with the word Pacing in the column header.

title: Exam season and Quiet the rest switches: 20px tall hit area on touch, and no role=switch
detail: The hub header's 'Exam season' switch and the Season page's 'Quiet the rest' are an input.k-switch (34x20) inside a label only as tall as its text (20px), so the touch target on iPad/iPhone is 20px tall (invariant 69 asks 44). Unlike storage.auto (role=switch) they announce as checkboxes.
evidence: measure on ipad: exams.season label height 20, input 34x20; js/modules/exams.js:263-270, js/modules/examviews.js:287-295 vs js/modules/storage.js:113
fix: Give .k-ex-seasonsw/.k-ex-quietsw min-block-size 44px under (pointer: coarse) and add role='switch' to both inputs.

title: Files list is one big aria-live region: every keystroke in search re-announces up to 300 cards
detail: The Files list container carries aria-live='polite' and paint() empties and refills it on every debounced search input, filter change and index event, so VoiceOver reads out the whole result list (names, kinds, sizes, links) after each letter typed.
evidence: js/modules/files.js:185 (aria-live on files.list), :238-249 paint() rebuilds it; search handler :202
fix: Drop aria-live from the list; announce one short line through KOS.a11y.announce ('12 files match') after a search/filter change (invariant 66).

title: Files list silently stops at 300 files
detail: paint() renders rows.slice(0, 300) with no 'and N more' line or pagination, so past 300 files (easy with a past-paper library: papers are listed here too) the rest just don't appear and nothing says so.
fix: Lazy-load in batches of 60 like the vaults (invariant 8) or print 'Showing 300 of N — search or filter to narrow'.

title: Pen and ink page leaves a dead block under 'On this device' on iPad landscape and Mac
detail: The four/five cards sit in a two-column grid with row-aligned heights: 'On this device' is ~180px tall beside 'Your pen' (~300px), leaving ~120px empty, and Ink sync is a short card beside the tall Kurenai card. The standing rule asks for no dead space; Reports uses masonry for uneven cards.
fix: Use the masonry/column flow (columns: 2 or the Reports 'pack' helper) for .k-pen-grid so short cards stack.

title: Exam Room's keep-awake is lost after the iPad is switched away and back
detail: The Exam Room requests a screen wake lock once on render. The browser releases a wake lock whenever the page is hidden (app switch, Control Centre, a notification opened); nothing re-requests it on visibilitychange, so after one switch the screen dims and locks during the countdown. KOS.desk (Focus) handles this by re-syncing on visibilitychange.
fix: Reuse KOS.desk's wake-lock helper, or listen for visibilitychange while the room is connected and re-request.

title: Marks by question: a question added with '＋ Question' can't be given its Max or its topic
detail: On #/exams/attempt/<uid>/marks the ＋ Question button adds a row whose only controls are Got and Redo: Max prints '—' and Topic is an empty read-only span. Only questions filled from the past-paper index carry max/refs. For a school mock, class paper or any paper not in the index (the common case) there is no way to record the out-of, so 'full marks', 'untagged · n', the total check and the post-mortem can't work, and a Redo on such a question has no leaf to be scheduled on (invariant 124 says a redo item is due on its question's leaf). Reproduced: clicking ＋ Question gave a row with inputs ['Got, question Q5', 'Redo question Q5'] and text 'Q5 | / | — | Redo'. The Topic column is therefore empty for every hand-logged attempt (dead column).
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/seed-marks-addq-ipad.png, audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/seed-marks-ipad.png; js/modules/examprac.js:410 addRow pushes {max:null, refs:[]}; :436-438 the row renders node title (read-only) and q.max as text; js/modules/tracker.js:192 questions only come from an index fill
fix: Make Max a small number input on rows without an index max, and the Topic cell a KOS.topicPicker button (scoped to the assessment's leaves) on every row; keep index-filled values as defaults.
rootCause: Marks page was built around index-filled questions; addRow never got editors for max/refs

title: Marks by question on touch: tag chips are 24px tall and the Got field 28px
detail: The ten 'Why marks went' tags are the main input of this page and sit in a dense 24px-tall wrap; the Got number field is 64x28. On the iPad (the device used for marking with a paper beside it) these are below the 44px touch minimum (invariant 69) and easy to mis-hit (adjacent chips 4px apart).
fix: Under (pointer: coarse) raise .k-ex-tag and .k-ex-gotin to 44px min-block-size (the row can grow), or switch to a two-column tag grid on touch.

title: Marks page: 'Use 19 · Keep 40' are unstyled text links that wrap apart, and a 'Keys · no mouse needed' card shows on touch devices
detail: When the questions don't add up to the total, the note ends with two k-link buttons 'Use 19' · 'Keep 40' that look like body text; on iPad 'Keep 40' wraps to its own line with a large gap, so the choice reads as a broken sentence. Below, a keyboard-shortcuts card ('no mouse needed': Tab, 1–0, R, arrows, Enter) is shown on an iPad with no keyboard.
fix: Render Use/Keep as two small buttons on their own row; show the Keys card only when (hover: hover) or a keyboard has been used (KOS.desk's hold-⌘ detection).

title: Exam Room on iPhone: the 'Before you go in' checklist is drawn on top of the rapid-recall list
detail: At 402px the room's body (ring, plan, five recall facts, blacklist) is taller than the screen, but .k-exr-body is a shrinkable flex item with min-block-size 0 inside the fixed, scrolling .k-exr column. It is squeezed to the leftover height and its content overflows visibly, so the checklist chips ('Black pens', 'Candidate number', 'Phone off and away') sit over facts 3–5 and both are unreadable; the blacklist is pushed off below. This is the screen meant to be used minutes before an exam on the phone.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/seed-room-iphone.png; css/views/exams.css:505 (.k-exr flex column, overflow-y auto) and :513 (.k-exr-body flex: 1 1 auto; min-block-size: 0); phone rules :933-937 don't change it
fix: Give .k-exr-body flex-shrink: 0 (or min-block-size: auto) so the room scrolls instead of overlapping; at phone width also consider putting the checklist right under the ring.
rootCause: flex item allowed to shrink below its content in a scroll container

title: Exam Room text over the classroom painting is low-contrast (blacklist on Mac, plan line on iPad)
detail: On the Mac the right column ('Your blacklist · three most frequent tags' and each step's explanation) lies over the bright windows of the painting: the grey sub-lines and the eyebrow are barely visible, and the numbered circles fade into the window frames. 'The plan: About 1.5 min a mark…' under the ring and 'Leave the Exam Room' are similarly faint on iPad and Mac.
fix: Put the side columns on the same frosted card the recall items use (with a darker scrim), or darken the painting layer behind text (a gradient scrim on the art layer 'exam:room'); raise muted text to --text-2 in the room.

title: Exam Room's countdown says 'until 09:00' when the exam is weeks away
detail: Opened 40 days before the exam (the route works at any time) the ring reads '40 days' over 'until 09:00', which reads as today at nine.
fix: When the exam is not today, say 'until Sat 12 Dec · 09:00'.

title: Small touch targets in the assessment page: Goals '＋' is 12x44, 'Edit' 22x44, checklist boxes 18x18
detail: On an assessment page the Goals card's add control is a k-link '＋' only 12px wide, 'On the day › Edit' is 22px wide, and the Before-you-go-in / checklist checkboxes are 18x18 (the Exam Room ticks too). On touch these are below invariant 69.
evidence: measure ipad/iphone #/exams/wkwsbeqr: exams.goal-add 12x44, button.k-link 'Edit' 22x44, exams.check 18x18; #/exams/<id>/room exams.room-check 18x18; js/modules/exams.js:846
fix: Use a k-btn--sm 'Add a goal' (the card already has one below), widen k-link hit areas with padding-inline on coarse pointers, and make the whole checklist row the label.

title: Exam Season on iPhone: 'Highest-risk topics' shows each topic as 'Finite …', 'Abstr…' (51px)
detail: The risk row is a fixed four-column grid (name, a fixed-width bar, %, Cram). At 402px the bar keeps its desktop width and the topic name gets 51px, so the card that tells you what to cram doesn't say which topics; the paper name under it wraps to two lines.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/seed-hub-iphone.png (Highest-risk topics card); measure: div.k-ex-strong 51x20 at x=38; css/views/exams.css:408 grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) var(--ex-bar-w) var(--sp-40) auto
fix: Under 560 drop the bar to its own row under the name (or shrink --ex-bar-w to ~48px) so the name gets the width.

title: Planner's 'Next week' preview is one run-on paragraph of titles and times
detail: With several assessments the preview prints every group as 'Title 1 h 40 · Title 1 h · …' plus the 'leaves the plan' sentences in one paragraph; on the Mac it runs 12+ lines where names and durations blur together ('Revision block 32 1 h 40 · Revision block 4 1 h 40 …'). The same page shows this week as a legend of name/time pairs.
fix: Render next week as compact rows (name · mono time, top 5 + 'and N more'), with 'leaves the plan' as its own muted line.

title: Planner allocation legend: a long name wraps under its colour dot, leaving the dot alone on a line
detail: In the allocation legend, entries whose title is long ('SAMPLE — Mock exam (edit me)', 'Graph traversal topic test with …') put the dot on one line and the title on the next, so their rows sit 14px lower than neighbours and the dot looks orphaned.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/seed-plan-mac.png (legend under the bar); js/modules/examviews.js:233 (dot + .k-ex-ell inside .k-ex-inline); css/views/exams.css:36 .k-ex-inline { flex-wrap: wrap }
fix: Use a non-wrapping row for the legend entry (flex-wrap: nowrap, the name min-inline-size: 0 with ellipsis).

title: Practice attempts: an unlabeled checkbox on every row
detail: Each attempt row ends with '–'/score, a bare checkbox and a pencil. The checkbox (aria-label 'Reviewed') has no visible label or column header, so it's unclear that it marks the attempt as reviewed; the '12 Not yet reviewed' tile is the only hint.
fix: Add a visible 'Reviewed' header over the column, or a small text toggle chip ('Reviewed ✓'); raise to 44px on touch.

title: Analytics opens on the nearest assessment even when it has no evidence, while Calibration below counts every paper
detail: #/exams/practice/analytics selects the first chip (a topic test with no papers): 'from 0 marked papers', 'Needs one marked paper…', 'Pace needs one timed paper', 'None timed yet' — while CS Paper 2 has six logged papers, and the Calibration card on the same page says '6 papers'. The page looks empty despite data, and mixes per-assessment and global scopes without saying so.
fix: Default to the assessment with the most marked papers (or remember the last pick per device), and label Calibration 'all papers'.

title: Predicted paper 1 for CS Paper 2 totals 99 marks and 2 h 29 min against a 100-mark, 2 h 30 board paper
detail: The paper's side card says Marks 99, Time 2 h 29 min, while its own note says 'Shaped like AQA CS Paper 2: 100 marks'. The blueprint fill stops one mark short and the time is derived from the marks, so a timed sitting is a minute short of the real exam.
fix: Let KOS.examPaper.build top up to the blueprint total (a 1-mark item or allow one item over) and take the time from the preset's durationMins.

title: Handwritten tab tells you pages 'stay on this device', but ink syncs to your account when signed in
detail: The empty band says 'Pages belong to 4.10.1 and stay on this device.' unconditionally. Since the ink sync release (invariant 136, kos_ink) pages replicate stroke by stroke to the user's own account when cloud sync is signed in; the Pen and ink page says so. The band's line misleads (and could put someone off writing on the iPad to read on the Mac).
fix: Branch on KOS.cloud.signedIn(): 'and sync to your other devices' when signed in, 'stay on this device (and in the full backup)' when not.

title: On iPhone the floating ink palette is 500px wide on a 402px screen: Undo and Redo are off-screen
detail: Under 700px the palette always floats in one row (the docked bar isn't offered). At 402px it measures 500px (x 20→520): grip 32, six tools at 44, the colour button still showing its text 'Ink · Mediu…' at 76, Undo and Redo at 44, plus gaps. The colour menu is cut and Undo/Redo are unreachable; dragging can't help because place() clamps x to max(20, W−w−20) = 20. Every pad, Handwritten tab, sketchbook and drill on the phone is affected.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/seed-ink-iphone.png; eval at iphone: ink.palette rect [20,716,500,62], scrollWidth 500, buttons '32x32 44x48 ×6 76x50 44x48 44x48'; js/core/inkui.js:1146-1171 (six tools + colour + history), css/views/ink.css:201-203 ('icons' state hides tool labels only)
fix: In the 'icons' state also hide the colour button's text (dot + caret only), and when root.scrollWidth > innerWidth − 40 move Shape and Ruler into the grip's More menu (or wrap to two rows). Clamp place() so a palette wider than the screen is centred and scrollable rather than clipped.
rootCause: Palette content width not budgeted for the phone tier

title: Floating palette's grip (the only way to Text, Image and Paper while floating) is 32x32
detail: The ⠿ grip both drags the palette and, on a tap, opens 'More tools' (Text, Image…, Paper…, Dock). It is 32x32 on the iPad and iPhone, below the 44px touch minimum, and nothing hints that it opens a menu; on the phone (always floating) Text and Paper are reachable only through it.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/seed-ink-float-ipad.png; eval at ipad: grip 'Move the palette, or more tools' 32x32; css/views/ink.css:204 (min-inline-size: var(--hit))
fix: Use --hit-coarse (44) under (pointer: coarse), and add a visible ⋯ More button to the palette rather than overloading the drag handle.

title: Topic tab strip on iPhone doesn't reveal the selected tab (Handwritten is off-screen)
detail: After opening Handwritten on a 402px phone the tab strip still shows Specification…Quiz and the selected tab is scrolled out of view, so the page gives no sign which tab you're on.
fix: Call the scroller's reveal on the active tab after openTab (KOS.ui.scroller({reveal})).
